description: i009 (SNAPSHOT=s08, BRANCH=xmit-softirq-lock) complete. Finding 1 (medium confidence): drivers/net/wireless/marvell/mwl8k.c:1991-2044, lock priv->stream_lock. Softirq side: mwl8k_tx (ieee80211_ops .tx registered in mwl8k_ops at mwl8k.c:5613, runs from mac80211 drv_tx under ndo_start_xmit/NET_TX softirq) -> mwl8k_txq_xmit (1898, called at 4705) takes stream_lock with plain spin_lock at lines 1992, 2056, 2079, 2129; the same function takes a different lock priv->tx_lock with spin_lock_bh at 2064/2125, proving the path expects BH-enabled execution while stream_lock lacks the _bh variant. Process/workqueue side, same lock object: hardirq mwl8k_interrupt at 4619-4621 calls ieee80211_queue_work(&priv->watchdog_ba_handle) -> mwl8k_watchdog_ba_events worker takes stream_lock plainly at 3835 (re-lock 3848); mwl8k_sta_remove (5324) -> mwl8k_cmd_set_new_stn_del (4157) takes it at 4165; mwl8k_ampdu_action (5444, ops at 5630) takes it at 5461. A file-wide grep shows all 16 stream_lock acquisitions are plain spin_lock with no spin_lock_bh/local_bh_disable variant. Impact hypothesis: worker/user-context holder on CPU N + NET_TX softirq on the same CPU executing mwl8k_txq_xmit spins forever on stream_lock -> soft lockup, RCU stall, TX-stall DoS, the exact seed mechanism. Also classified: qtnfmac trans.c resp_lock (lines 30/47/87/136) unresolved - its rx-ctl callback dispatch was traced to shm_ipc irq_work workqueue context, not NET softirq, and data_tx uses spin_lock_irqsave; ks7010 seed present unpatched at drivers/staging/ks7010/ks7010_sdio.c:398 but explicitly excluded; cw1200 wsm.c, hostap_ap.c/hostap_hw.c, iwlwifi pcie/rx.c, and staging rtl8723bs/rtl8192u/rtl8192e/wlan-ng listed as unresolved high-density candidates not traced before the deadline. Static analysis only; no runtime reproducer (tree lacks .config/headers). Artifact: agent-state/findings/i009.json with snapshots_checked ["s08"], 1 finding, 7 candidates, 4 limitations.
